text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The Classic Triple Crown campaign—consisting of
the Satsuki Sho, the Japanese Derby, and the Kikuka Sho—
is finally about to begin.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Gathering the brilliant talents of their generation,
this supreme race to decide the "generation's strongest" is—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: It's the once-in-a-lifetime dream stage that an Umamusume can only challenge once in her life.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: "Above all, the first leg, the Satsuki Sho, is often contested before an Umamusume has fully developed her abilities, making innate talent considered essential."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
With the entry deadline for the Satsuki Sho fast approaching,
I called Cheval Grand over.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Considering her temperament,
running on such a grand, illustrious stage must take a heavy mental toll on her.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: However, her dream of becoming a "great Umamusume"—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—If your goal is to boldly take on major races,
earning victory and thunderous applause...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
We need to understand where we currently stand.
In that sense, this race is a precious opportunity
to run alongside the top Umamusume of our generation.

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
Um... Trainer-san.
A-Are we really entering the Satsuki Sho—?
choice_data_list: Just chalk it up to experience and give it a shot!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And so arrived the day of the Satsuki Sho—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Cheval Grand was completely intimidated.

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: ...What should I do...? I'm totally out of place here...

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: …………I got so full of myself...

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: U... Uuuu......gh.

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: Pyaaauughhh!?

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: Ah, I'm sorr...... N-never mind...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Seeing her look like a cornered little animal only deepened my sense of guilt.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I decided to enter the race thinking it was for
Cheval Grand's sake, but it seems it was too much
of a burden for her at this stage after all.
choice_data_list: Sorry, I forced you into it, didn't I?
I'm sorry, I pushed you too hard, didn't I?

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: Ah... n-no, it can't be...

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
—What am I doing...?
Trainer went through so much trouble for me...!

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: This is what you... want to change about yourself, right...? Being timid, being a coward...—

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: Nnnrgh.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Clap, clap—!)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Perhaps trying to psych herself up,
Cheval Grand slapped her own cheeks
and turned toward me with teary eyes.

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: ...I-I'm fine. I... I can d-do this.

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
If I want to become a "great Umamusume"...
I can't just keep being scared...!

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: I will run... properly...
choice_data_list: ...I'll be keeping a close eye on you, okay?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Having somehow managed to psych herself up, I saw Cheval Grand off from the waiting room—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
When I headed to the paddock,
a large crowd of fans had already gathered.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Who is the fastest Umamusume of this generation?
Perhaps because that question will soon be answered,
the cheers from the fans for the runners are ablaze with passion.

text_block_list.name: Crown Fan
text_block_list.text:
Crown!!
Please, claim the "glory" befitting of you!!

text_block_list.name: Duramente Fan
text_block_list.text:
Duramenteee!
Unleash those powerful legs of yours!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (――WOOOAAAHHH!!!!)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Walking at the head of the group is Satono Crown.
She came in first in the recent popularity poll,
making her the standout star of this generation.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"In terms of drawing attention,
Duramente has a commanding presence as well."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Closing in all at once in the final stretch with a wild, rough running style
and pulling away from the pack around her
truly showcases the immense raw talent she was born with.
choice_data_list: (These two will surely make the race today.)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"How deeply Cheval Grand can break into that fray.
It's not that I think she has no chance at all, but――"

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
I came here bearing the hopes of my family.
Today... I will not lose.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: Very well... But the "strongest" is me.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Kura-chan...
Duramente-san...

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: ......No, I'm okay!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: I absolutely won't lose either...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
With their respective destinies on the line,
the battle for the Classic Triple Crown begins now—!
